text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, this is Aston Machan. It's the 
final day of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A lot happened during the training camp. I 
even almost caught summer fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I went out for a little trip with Trainer 
too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've come to understand you a 
little bit better, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...One step forward. The next step begins 
now."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best in autumn, too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's all from Aston Machan on this 
summer day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer-san. When did you get here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the summer training camp with 
Aston Machan came to an end.
